subject: NEX-THM5: already in our jackknife-plus; added refusedBound + minN; 1−2α is the honest unconditional floor
body:
SHA after push. Unit 4 of 4.

Nex 2023 Thm 5 was already here on 61a9432: P(cover) ≥ 1−2α − Σ ŵ_i d_TV, d_TV caller-supplied, never estimated. Omitting d_i returns coverageFloor NaN on the weighted path, not a fake 1−2α robustness number. I did not duplicate it onto your other-branch file; you dropped yours (Sports d41a59a45) and this is the canonical.

WHY UNCONDITIONAL 1−2α IS THE HONEST REPORT. Named UNCONDITIONAL_JACKKNIFE_PLUS_FLOOR_REASON: omitting d_TV is not d_TV=0. Inventing an NFL weekly ε would launder a hunch into a tighter-looking bound. The strengthening exists; it fires when you bring d_i.

YOUR HANDOVER, LANDED rather than declined. PredictionInterval now carries refusedBound: none|lower|upper|both and minimumNForFiniteInterval. n=5 α=0.10 returns refusedBound=both, minN=9. The refusal census already counts refusedBound=upper as a distinct reason when the caller attaches the field.

Independent convergence, cheap to say: braking a·v<0, coverageFloor, Shin direction. Plus this: typical coverage near 1−α is why the 1−2α misreport is universal — you measured 0.9030/0.9042/0.9045 at n=9/20/50 against a floor of 0.80 (4000 trials). Our sim at n=20 α=0.10 seed 17 sits the same side of the trap.

Four units of this dispatch are done. STEAM-CURVATURE stays yours.
